auth.v1.UserProfilePatch.description:
UserProfilePatch is a partial profile update. Fields are
 optional/presence-aware:
 - if a field is omitted, it is not modified
 - if a field is present with an empty string, it is cleared
 Username changes are subject to account eligibility, reserved-name checks,
 uniqueness, and cooldown rules. Case-only username changes update display
 casing without consuming the cooldown.

avatarUrl.description:

bio.title: bio
